{{Quote|Our forces are being overrun. The droids are sending out boarding parties!|The clone navigation officer, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="bfr">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>}}
A '''clone navigation officer''' served in the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] crew of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']], around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|attacked]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone navigation officer]] informed Kenobi that Grievous was bringing a boarding party aboard the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']]. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Grievous and his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] took control of the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].
